modules.name: Comper
modules.description: Jazz piano comping player: rootless, shell, quartal and spread voicings with real voice leading, swung two-bar rhythm figures that push into the next chord, a LOOSE knob for human hands, and a LISTEN input that leaves room for a soloist. Notes out; bring your own piano

modules.name: Walker
modules.description: Bass player for Comper: walking, two-feel, ballad, bossa, soul and house lines that lean into each chord, played on a modelled upright bass with a real pluck, a ringing body and human hands. Follows Comper with no cables. Audio and notes out

modules.name: Rider
modules.description: Drummer for Comper and Walker: an improvising jazz drummer that keeps time on the ride, comps on snare and bass drum, catches the pianist's pushes, sets up the ends of phrases and plays a modelled jazz kit with sticks or brushes. Follows the band with no cables. Stereo audio and triggers out
